title: Programming Practice Lab verified on local web
summary: Verified all nine challenge records, saved answers and notes, language filters, retries, daily selection and Home/My tools navigation. Reviewed mobile screenshots.

changes.detail: Keep the practice progress fraction left-to-right within Arabic layouts and reset scroll position when opening a challenge.
Real JavaScript and SQLite answer-key verification plus disposable browser coverage for practice interactions and persistence.

validation.name: TypeScript and focused lint
validation.detail: npm.cmd run typecheck and ESLint passed for all changed application TS/TSX files.

validation.name: Automated tests
validation.detail: 12 tests passed: five Practice Lab tests, six history tests and the speaking interaction regression. All JavaScript and SQL answer keys match actual Node/SQLite execution.

validation.name: Browser interactions
validation.detail: Disposable Edge browser verified disabled submission, language filters, mini-lesson, wrong and correct answers, hints, retries, notes and attempts after reload, non-inflating first-try counts, empty filter and Home/My tools entry links. Authentication mocked; no real credentials.

validation.name: Responsive and visual review
validation.detail: 18 library width checks at 320/390/900 across Arabic, English, French and light/dark themes; six challenge layout checks; no page errors. Reviewed Arabic light, Arabic dark challenge, English light and French dark Home screenshots.

validation.name: History
validation.detail: History check passed with 278 reports before this linked report; prior reports preserved.

validation.name: Limitations
validation.detail: Python snippets reviewed manually but not executed: local python/py launchers were unavailable. Native Android/iOS testing and deployment not performed. Code challenges are reasoning exercises, not an embedded runtime or certification.
